create_EMAState_from_model: create an EMAState object from a PyTorch model using the from_model class method
update_EMAState_with_model: update the EMA state by calling update with the current model after each training step
apply_EMAState_to_model: apply the stored EMA weights back to the model using the apply_to method
load_EMAState_state_dict: load EMA state from a serialized state dictionary using the load_state_dict method
move_EMAState_to_device: move the EMA state tensors to a specified device using the to method
